title: Zephyr: dispatch classification
close_reason: Implemented spec-conformant fail-closed L2 dispatch classification across Python, Rust, and Zephyr C: only 0x14 SCHC and 0x15 routing are assigned, defined dispatches require a body byte, reserved 0x16 is rejected, and exhaustive/canonical shared-vector tests pass. Verified Python focused vectors 270/270, Rust core 310/310 plus lichen-link shared vector/no_std/clippy, strict standalone C/clang-tidy/cppcheck, and isolated Zephyr qemu_x86 3/3.
